paper-main-classification: Nature Communications Results and Figure 2: Pax2 was highly expressed in I1-I7; I8 lacked Pax2 but shared Mpped2 with the other interneuron clusters and was initially described as a suspected rare cholinergic interneuron.

paper-methods-sample-frame: Nature Communications Methods, Single nucleus isolation and sequencing: 12 eight-week-old mice (6 female, 6 male), matching regions pooled from two mice, and three processing replicates comprising male, female, and mixed-sex tissue.

paper-interneuron-section: Nature Communications Cholinergic interneurons section and Figure 5: eight source clusters were used for the main analysis; 14 finer subclasses lacked robustly distinct markers and showed no rostrocaudal differences; I1-I4 carried Slc6a1/Mpped2 context and Piezo2 was also detected in I1 and I7.

paper-figure-5-i8: Nature Communications Figure 5d-f and associated text: Piezo2, Reln, and Chat co-expression validates a rare I8 population in the intermediate zone around the central canal; this is population-level ISH context, not a coordinate for deposited nuclei.

study-missing-axes: Neither the deposited annotation object nor the retained I1-I8 evidence supplies per-nucleus xyz coordinates, neurite or soma geometry, intracellular structures, electrophysiology, projection targets, synaptic edges, SCI states, atlas transforms, or cross-source identities.

records.boundary: The 1,545 cells and 1,545 GSM accessions are cell-level sampling units, not 1,545 animals or independent biological replicates; the biological source denominator is 28 animals partitioned 3, 5, and 20 across the reported sampling cohorts. P17-P28 is a project conventional normalization of the deposited age(days) values 17-28. The source does not assert an adult, juvenile, or young-adult category for the sequencing cohort. The source reports 1,639 post-QC neurons before final manual curation, 94 source-labelled excluded cells, and 1,545 final cells assigned to 30 types after initial BackSPIN clustering. These are pipeline-stage counts, not independent biological replicates or biological prevalence. Rows 2 through 7 are cell-column metadata and rows 8 through 24,385 are 24,378 gene rows. Age, deposited sex codes, strain, raw clusters, and standard names are cell-column attributes; their counts must not be promoted to independent-animal denominators. The source reports type-level cervical density maps across two animals and six sections; this is not an xyz coordinate, a same-cell localization, or a transform into the project atlas. Four source discrepancies remain visible and unharmonized. Search and co-display do not establish cross-source identity.

records.boundary: The 1,545 cells and 1,545 GSM accessions are cell-level sampling units, not 1,545 animals or independent biological replicates; the biological source denominator is 28 animals partitioned 3, 5, and 20 across the reported sampling cohorts. P17-P28 is a project conventional normalization of the deposited age(days) values 17-28. The source does not assert an adult, juvenile, or young-adult category for the sequencing cohort. The source reports 1,639 post-QC neurons before final manual curation, 94 source-labelled excluded cells, and 1,545 final cells assigned to 30 types after initial BackSPIN clustering. These are pipeline-stage counts, not independent biological replicates or biological prevalence. Rows 2 through 7 are cell-column metadata and rows 8 through 24,385 are 24,378 gene rows. Age, deposited sex codes, strain, raw clusters, and standard names are cell-column attributes; their counts must not be promoted to independent-animal denominators. The source reports type-level cervical density maps across two animals and six sections; this is not an xyz coordinate, a same-cell localization, or a transform into the project atlas. Four source discrepancies remain visible and unharmonized. Search and co-display do not establish cross-source identity.

records.boundary: The 1,545 cells and 1,545 GSM accessions are cell-level sampling units, not 1,545 animals or independent biological replicates; the biological source denominator is 28 animals partitioned 3, 5, and 20 across the reported sampling cohorts. P17-P28 is a project conventional normalization of the deposited age(days) values 17-28. The source does not assert an adult, juvenile, or young-adult category for the sequencing cohort. The source reports 1,639 post-QC neurons before final manual curation, 94 source-labelled excluded cells, and 1,545 final cells assigned to 30 types after initial BackSPIN clustering. These are pipeline-stage counts, not independent biological replicates or biological prevalence. Rows 2 through 7 are cell-column metadata and rows 8 through 24,385 are 24,378 gene rows. Age, deposited sex codes, strain, raw clusters, and standard names are cell-column attributes; their counts must not be promoted to independent-animal denominators. The source reports type-level cervical density maps across two animals and six sections; this is not an xyz coordinate, a same-cell localization, or a transform into the project atlas. Four source discrepancies remain visible and unharmonized. Search and co-display do not establish cross-source identity.

records.boundary: The 1,545 cells and 1,545 GSM accessions are cell-level sampling units, not 1,545 animals or independent biological replicates; the biological source denominator is 28 animals partitioned 3, 5, and 20 across the reported sampling cohorts. P17-P28 is a project conventional normalization of the deposited age(days) values 17-28. The source does not assert an adult, juvenile, or young-adult category for the sequencing cohort. The source reports 1,639 post-QC neurons before final manual curation, 94 source-labelled excluded cells, and 1,545 final cells assigned to 30 types after initial BackSPIN clustering. These are pipeline-stage counts, not independent biological replicates or biological prevalence. Rows 2 through 7 are cell-column metadata and rows 8 through 24,385 are 24,378 gene rows. Age, deposited sex codes, strain, raw clusters, and standard names are cell-column attributes; their counts must not be promoted to independent-animal denominators. The source reports type-level cervical density maps across two animals and six sections; this is not an xyz coordinate, a same-cell localization, or a transform into the project atlas. Four source discrepancies remain visible and unharmonized. Search and co-display do not establish cross-source identity.

paper-figure-7-p31: PMC8601153 Figure 7A and Results P31: every numbered cluster contained both Chx10-high putative Type I and Chx10-low putative Type II cells; clusters 6-8 had the highest Chx10-low fractions.

paper-results-p32: PMC8601153 Results P32 and Figure S7A: bulk-signature analysis computationally assigned 455 cells as cervical and 494 as lumbar; clusters 6 and 8 were mostly cervical, clusters 1, 2, and 10 lumbar-enriched, and clusters 3-5 mixed.

provenance.label: Hayashi neonatal V2a source-local taxonomy
provenance.citation: Hayashi M, Hinckley CA, Driscoll SP, Moore NJ, Levine AJ, Hilde KL, Sharma K, Pfaff SL. Graded Arrays of Spinal and Supraspinal V2a Interneuron Subtypes Underlie Forelimb and Hindlimb Motor Control. Neuron. 2018;97:869-884.e5.
locators: paper-figure-6: PMC8601153 Figure 6A-C and caption P110-P112: two P0 neonates, 12,986 detected genes, 949 retained neurons, and 11 numbered clusters with displayed cell counts 144, 130, 121, 117, 112, 86, 59, 52, 51, 48, and 29.

paper-results-p30: PMC8601153 Results P30: clusters 3-5 were enriched for Nfib, Tcf4, NeuroD2, and Sp8 and mapped to medial V2a context; clusters 1, 2, 6-8, and 10 were enriched for Zfhx3, Zfhx4, Nefl, and Shox2 and mapped to lateral V2a context.

paper-figure-7-p31: PMC8601153 Figure 7A and Results P31: every numbered cluster contained both Chx10-high putative Type I and Chx10-low putative Type II cells; clusters 6-8 had the highest Chx10-low fractions.

paper-results-p32: PMC8601153 Results P32 and Figure S7A: bulk-signature analysis computationally assigned 455 cells as cervical and 494 as lumbar; clusters 6 and 8 were mostly cervical, clusters 1, 2, and 10 lumbar-enriched, and clusters 3-5 mixed.

study-missing-axes: The admitted transcriptomic object and article-level subtype analysis do not provide barcode-linked single-cell morphology, cell xyz, atlas transforms, synaptic edge lists, adult or SCI identity, animal-resolved transcriptomic replication, or exact cross-source identities.

records.boundary: Two source animals pooled into one 10x library are not two independently analyzable transcriptomic replicates. The 949 cells are sampling units, not specimens. The article's 455 cervical and 494 lumbar assignments are computational and are not deposited as columns in the public GEO count matrix. Figure 6 cluster counts are article-reported and not independently reproducible from the bare public matrix without a cluster-to-barcode map.

evidence.label: Causal mechanism
evidence.value: In the source study, AAV-DTR was delivered two weeks before complete crush SCI and diphtheria toxin was administered at eight weeks to ablate thoracic Vsx2ON neurons; the ablation prevented natural walking recovery. The study also reports a separate rejuvenative gene-therapy experiment.
